in_shape.description: Sequence of integers specifying the input spatial shape.

window_shape.description: Sequence of integers specifying the kernel/window spatial shape.

window_strides.description: Sequence of integers specifying the spatial strides.

padding.description: Either a padding string (``'SAME'``, ``'SAME_LOWER'``, or ``'VALID'``) or a ``PaddingType`` enum value. Other values will result in an error.
constraints: padding must be one of SAME, SAME_LOWER, VALID, PaddingType

output.description: A list of ``(low, high)`` integer tuples, one for each spatial dimension, specifying the padding to apply before and after each dimension.
